description: Leanroute MCP: route to 13 LLM providers, check pricing/usage/credit, manage keys from any agent.
name: dev.leanroute/mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: Admin API key (gw_admin_*). Mint at https://leanroute.dev/dashboard/admin-keys. Required for platform tools (pricing, usage, credit, key management).
environmentVariables.name: LEANROUTE_ADMIN_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Runtime API key (gw_live_*). Mint at https://leanroute.dev/dashboard/keys. Optional — only required for the route_call tool that dispatches actual LLM completions.
environmentVariables.name: LEANROUTE_RUNTIME_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Base URL override for self-hosted Leanroute instances.
environmentVariables.name: LEANROUTE_BASE_URL
